environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed behind CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net) with Origin Access Control (OAC) v2 signing. The distribution has a custom origin pointing to the API Gateway execute-api endpoint with origin path /prod. CloudFront behaviors configured with Viewer Protocol Policy: HTTPS Only, and a custom cache policy with URI query string forwarding limited to 'Signature', 'Expires', 'Key-Pair-Id' parameters only. The distribution uses a Trusted Key Group (kg-9f8e7d6c) for signed URL validation with RSA-2048 key pair, requiring valid CloudFront signed URLs for ALL requests (no unsigned request paths configured). CloudFront's default URI normalization performs percent-encoding normalization on the request URI BEFORE forwarding to origin, which collapses percent-encoded unicode sequences. Additionally, the CloudFront Function (cf-func-uri-sanitize) attached to viewer-request event performs NFKC normalization and rejects any request where the post-normalization path contains '../', '..%2F', or any character outside the printable ASCII range (0x20-0x7E), returning 403. The S3 bucket policy restricts GetObject to requests originating from the specific CloudFront distribution ARN via aws:SourceArn condition.

config.signed_urls: Required for all paths, Trusted Key Group kg-9f8e7d6c, RSA-2048
config.cache_policy: query string forwarding limited to Signature/Expires/Key-Pair-Id
config.cloudfront_function: cf-func-uri-sanitize on viewer-request: NFKC normalize then reject if path contains traversal sequences or non-ASCII (outside 0x20-0x7E)
config.uri_normalization: CloudFront default percent-encoding normalization before origin forwarding
config.s3_bucket_policy: GetObject only via aws:SourceArn matching CloudFront distribution ARN
config.direct_origin_access: API Gateway resource policy denies all except CloudFront IP ranges (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing)
